title: Dragon Ball Super
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Set after the defeat of Majin Boo, Goku and Vegeta meet Beerus, the God of Destruction, and train under his angel attendant Whis to reach god-level power. They fight in inter-universe tournaments, face Goku Black (the rogue deity-in-training Zamas who seeks to wipe out mortals), and compete in the Tournament of Power, where defeated universes are erased by the childlike supreme ruler Zeno.
life_message: It holds up endless self-improvement, friendly rivalry and protecting one's world and friends.

content.note: Constant martial-arts battles; killing is common and sometimes celebrated though not graphic; whole universes erased (CSM 10+ on the anime; Wikipedia).
Annihilation stakes, intimidating aliens and a genocidal god (Wikipedia; CSM).
CSM finds no sexual content in the anime; Master Roshi's lechery gags appear (to verify in manga; MangaDex suggestive).
Disagreements settled by fighting (CSM); Goku's recklessness risking others for an exciting match (to verify).
Huge franchise with games, films and merchandise (CSM); manga follows the anime (Wikipedia).
